description: Use this when someone wants new build homes, new builds or new homes for sale in a place: by price, bedrooms, house, flat or bungalow, house builder, part exchange or another builder offer, price reductions, or schools nearby. Returns the number of matching homes and developments, the homes on this page (price, status, bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area, tenure, the builder offer, the date each was checked and its page address), and a link to the same search on newhomesearch.co.uk. Only homes for sale today unless include asks for more. New build homes only: not resale homes or rentals.

any_offer.description: Only homes with an offer of any kind.

builder.description: A house builder, as the buyer named it.

include.description: Also show homes in these states. By default only homes for sale today are shown.

offers.description: Only homes whose builder states one of these offers, for example part_exchange, stamp_duty_paid or deposit_contribution.

place.description: Where to search: a town, city, county, council area, postcode district or full postcode. A full postcode searches within 10 miles of it unless within_miles says otherwise. Leave out only to search the whole UK.

place_option.description: Which of several places with that name, by the option number a previous call returned.

reduced.description: Only homes reduced in price since first listed.

schools.description: Only homes within reach of at least one school of each kind asked: kind any, primary, secondary, grammar or independent; grade outstanding or good; results top10, top25 or above (DfE results against England). England only.

types.description: house covers every house type; flat includes maisonettes.

within_miles.description: Search within this many miles of the place rather than inside its boundary.

name: search_homes
title: Search new build homes
